CI is running in the background (including the new Promptfoo Evals job); I'll check back once it completes. In the meantime, here's a summary of the work done.

## Summary

Opened [PR #417](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/417) closing all 4 findings from the "AI Architecture / Domain Accuracy & Quality" review:

1. **Domain Accuracy** — found the gap was narrower than described (enforcePolicy() already gates ~12 LLM call sites). The two real gaps were the Reports & Analysis Engine's two AI surfaces (`runAiRecipe()`, `proposeReportFromUpload()`), which had zero policy gate despite accepting user-supplied free text. Added the missing `enforcePolicy()` calls plus a new `hasGroundingData()` check that refuses to generate a "grounded" report narrative when there's no actual data to ground it in.
2. **AI Tests** — extended `promptfooconfig.yaml` with report and capability-audit prompt evals, fixed the provider to one this repo can actually reach in CI (Groq, since `OPENAI_API_KEY` was never provisioned), and added a new CI workflow so these run automatically on relevant PRs instead of manually only.
3. **AI Innovation** — added the software-first/AI-second architecture as a named differentiator on the real marketing landing page.
4. **Cognitive AI OS consistency** — documented `embeddings.ts`/`whisper-client.ts` as approved capability-tree/policy-gate exceptions in the constitution (additive only).

Verified clean typecheck, lint, full test suite (1391 pass), and all 5 governance CI scripts locally before opening the PR. Not self-merged, per the repo's audit rules — left for the supervising session.
